notes.title: steam curator reviews
notes.content:
You can see reviews of FlyingMetalSuit on those steam curator.
in english :

VR Goldgrabbers
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32247615-VR-Goldgrabbers/
"Good flights on difficult routes. High speed adds immersion, and control in the style of a superhero movie is done well."

Earth in a Porthole
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32668243-Earth-in-the-Porthole/
"FlyingMetalSuit is a fun flying superheroes simulator game for VR. Great impressions of speed and movement, simple gameplay (it got 12 levels) and pleasant graphism. Surprising and entertaining game!"

Virtual Reality manual Book 
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32706805-Virtual-Reality-Manual-Book/
"If the opportunity to fly like iron man isn't enough, what about being able to race this way? FlyingMetalSuit is a VR super hero racing game in the air. You can use boost or rocket to take others down"

The best VR games on PC
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32820306-The-best-VR-games-on-PC/

in other langage :
aga i my
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/7690491-Aga-i-my/
"TAK/ latamy jak ajron man "
https://steamcommunity.com/id/agakolo930/recommended/692840

Play, enjoy, write reviews
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32826073-Play-enjoy-write-reviews/
"VR-гонки на джетпаках, незабываемая атмосфера полета, грамотно составленные уровни, поначалу аж дух захватывает, привыкаешь не сразу, хотя и спустя время все равно ощущается прилив адреналина, круто."

VrGames and all all all 
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32820358-VR-Games-and-All-All-All/
"Симулятор полетов для VR в костюме железного человека. Графика на уровне управление достаточно хорошее и отзывчивое. Временами голова идет кругом, так что не каждый сможет быть супер-героем."

oui/non
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33005345-OUI-NON/

notes.title: Update available
notes.content:
A new update is available for FlyingMetalSuit on 14.03.2019.
 One bonus race track and 2 bonus stage with alternative game mode. Also some bug correction on Collision and Ranking.
Sorry for the long wait !

notes.title: Oculus Rift and Touch
notes.content: Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch are now supported on FlyingMetalSuit !

notes.title: Update available for control input
notes.content:
An update is available to take care of the problem with some input specially with the rocket and menu input. 
Sorry for the bad update from before. This new update will take care of the problem , its only 15mo.
Thanks to the people who warned me about this issue.
